jobs.occupation: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks
Battery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies 
We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Your work tasks
This PhD position focuses on the application of quantum computing to computational challenges in power systems with high shares of renewable energy. You will investigate quantum and hybrid quantum–classical methods for power system analysis and optimization, with emphasis on their practical performance and suitability for real-time applications.

Your work will include formulating representative power system analysis and optimization problems, developing and implementing quantum and hybrid quantum–classical solution methods, and comparing their performance with relevant classical approaches. You will also evaluate the developed methods through numerical studies and real-time power system simulation. The research will involve scientific programming, analysis and documentation of results, and dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and international conferences.

The position is offered within the Center for Research on Microgrids, and the PhD student will be affiliated with the Electric Power Systems and Microgrids section at AAU Energy.

Your competencies 
The applicant must have a relevant educational background in electrical engineering, energy engineering, computer science, or a closely related field. You should have a solid foundation in mathematical modelling and numerical methods, together with experience in scientific programming, preferably in Python. Knowledge of power system analysis and optimization (e.g., power flow and optimal power flow), as well as experience with quantum computing methods and algorithms (e.g., HHL or variational quantum linear solvers for linear system problems, and QAOA or quantum annealing for optimization problems), is expected.

Experience with real-time power system simulation using platforms such as RTDS or OPAL-RT would be an advantage. Previous peer-reviewed journal publications at the intersection of quantum computing and power and energy systems would also be considered an advantage. You should be motivated to further develop your expertise across both power systems and quantum computing.

You should be able to organize and conduct research independently, document and communicate your methods and results clearly, and discuss technical challenges constructively with colleagues. Role and impact:

As Principal Cost Estimator, you will play a pivotal role in preparing competitive cost estimates for Topsoe’s proprietary hardware and total installed costs for proposals and studies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including licensing, business development, proposal management, project teams, product management, and process and mechanical engineering—to provide expert cost-estimation advice that supports strategic management decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparing cost estimates for proprietary hardware and total installed costs for proposals and studies

• 
Contributing to early-study and Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) cost estimates

• 
Understanding the scope, contract, schedule, project execution approach, local conditions, construction execution, and financing assumptions relevant to each proposal

• 
Planning estimate methodologies that meet customer expectations

• 
Reviewing and benchmarking estimates using experience data and checking estimate quality

• 
Developing cost-estimation tools, methods, processes, and products

• 
Supporting standardization and effective execution of Topsoe technology solutions

• 
Presenting cost information to management to support decision-making

• 
Coordinating cost reviews with internal departments and, where relevant, customers and other teams

Your work will have a direct impact on the competitiveness and quality of Topsoe’s proposals and project delivery. You will also drive improvements in standardization and execution of Topsoe technology solutions, ensuring all estimates are well-founded, benchmarked, and aligned with project scope, schedule, and customer expectations.

What you will bring:

You bring a broad understanding of cost estimating, cost engineering, or related fields, ideally with experience in mechanical, process, or chemical engineering. Familiarity with Topsoe’s proprietary hardware design and technology solutions is highly valued. You are comfortable working with incomplete data and can apply structured, efficient methodologies to deliver high-quality estimates under pressure.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 
Ideally, around 10 years of relevant mechanical/process/cost estimating/cost engineering, or similar

• 
Strong collaboration and networking skills, enabling you to build effective relationships across disciplines

• 
Motivation for knowledge-sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement

• 
The ability to work in a structured, efficient way, manage multiple tasks, and maintain focus under pressure

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English (Danish is advantageous but not required)

• 
Flexibility and openness to improving ways of working and contributing to the ongoing development of estimation tools, methods, and processes

• 
Experience in an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) environment are considered relevant, but not mandatory.

Joining Topsoe means becoming part of a global leader in advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition. You will have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that drive sustainability and energy resiliency worldwide.

- A collaborative and inclusive culture where your expertise is valued

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

Drive Commercial Excellence across a global organization and turn strategy into measurable business impact.

At Topsoe, we are accelerating the energy transition through world-leading technologies and solutions. To support our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Global Commercial Excellence who can help transform commercial strategy into measurable business results across our global commercial organization.

This is a unique opportunity for a commercially minded transformation leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, analytics, and change leadership.

The role

You will lead a team of specialists and project managers while working closely with commercial leaders across regions, business units, and functions. Your mission will be to identify and unlock commercial value, improve commercial effectiveness, and ensure that Commercial Excellence initiatives create measurable business impact.

A key priority for the role will be to establish pricing excellence and deliver measurable margin improvement. Beyond pricing, you will help strengthen sales effectiveness, customer impact, and cost-to-serve performance through improved commercial processes, capabilities, tools, and data-driven decision making.

You will act as a catalyst for change, ensuring that new ways of working become embedded and deliver lasting results.

Key responsibilities:

• Lead and develop Topsoe's Commercial Excellence function.

• Partner with commercial leaders to identify value creation opportunities and translate them into actionable initiatives.

• Strengthen the use of commercial data, analytics, CRM, and digital tools to support decision making.

• Monitor business impact and establish clear performance measures for Commercial Excellence activities

The role requires physical presence in Lyngby.

What you bring

You know how to turn commercial ambition into measurable business performance. You’ve led complex transformation—from identifying where value is created to making new ways of working stick.

You bring:

• A track record of delivering commercial transformation and lasting business impact.

• Deep understanding of commercial value drivers, such as pricing, sales effectiveness, customer management and profitability.

• The judgment to connect data, customer insight and business priorities—and focus effort where it will make the greatest difference.

• The influence to align senior leaders and teams across functions, businesses and geographies, even when you don’t have formal authority.

• The leadership to build trust, challenge constructively and create real ownership for change.

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

Direct leadership experience is necessary, however while experience in industrial B2B is advantageous, it is not a requirement. We are interested in what you have delivered and how you have made change endure.

You’re a strategic operator: you see the bigger picture, make complexity actionable and stay close enough to execution to deliver results. You bring commercial rigor and curiosity, and you’re willing to question established practices when there is a better way to create value.

You build momentum by bringing people with you—setting clear direction, earning trust and turning shared priorities into changed behavior. You don’t just launch initiatives; you help embed the capabilities and ways of working that keep improving performance over time.

Why join us

You will be part of the Global Commercial leadership team and have the opportunity to shape how Commercial Excellence contributes to Topsoe's future success. The role offers significant visibility across the organization and the opportunity to influence strategic priorities, commercial performance, and value creation at a global scale.

At Topsoe, we are united by a shared purpose: helping our customers and partners accelerate the energy transition. You will join a company built on innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to solving some of the world's most important challenges.

Your new team

The Commercial Excellence team is part of Global Commercial and consists of dedicated specialists and project managers supporting pricing, sales effectiveness, CRM, commercial processes, tools, and capability development.

The team works closely with commercial leaders across the organization and serves as a catalyst for continuous improvement and commercial performance.

How to apply

If you would like to be part of a global company that combines technology leadership with meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

The role will primarily support chemical analyses within the Food Science Laboratory. Candidates with relevant experience in physical analytical methods may have the opportunity to initially support physical analyses before transitioning into a chemistry-focused role. “In our team, we apply and develop a wide range of analytical methods to evaluate both the chemical composition and physical behaviour of our products. How you will make an impact

A typical task covers the following

• Taking in a request, coordinating and planning laboratory trials and analyses.

• Executing and reporting trials and analysis.

• Data handling, ordering the needed chemicals and maintaining our equipment.

• Our main chemistry analytical methods include GC-MS, LC-TOF, LC-QTOF and IC.

• Our main physical analytical methods include NMR, viscosity, light scattering methods, texture, stability test and advanced microscopy

• Data treatment is a big part of daily work.

What will make you successful

We expect that you have a degree as Laboratory Technician (in Danish “laborant”). Experience in chemical laboratory analyses is an advantage. Experience with physical analytical methods such as NMR, viscosity measurements, light scattering methods, texture analysis, stability testing or advanced microscopy is required for candidates who wish to start in our physical laboratory before transitioning into a chemistry-focused role.

Finally, we offer you a team that values open communication, good team spirit, passion for science, trust and respect.

Application and contact

jobs.occupation: Project Planning Specialist, Medium Voltage Products
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Product Marketing Manager

__

**What we believe in:

**At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

**Role and tasks

**As Project Planning Specialist, you will combine project planning and control with operational sales administration support within ABB’s Medium Voltage Products business. Working closely with project managers and colleagues across sales administration, engineering, finance, procurement and operations, you will create reliable schedules, maintain accurate SAP data and provide clear insights into project costs, revenue, cash flow, risks and opportunities.

The role is designed with a broad scope. Alongside project planning responsibilities, you will support the sales administration team during peak workload periods and planned absences and help administer project-related financial guarantees. Your work will contribute to reliable project delivery, accurate commercial data and continuity in day-to-day operations. The position is based at our office in Middelfart and follows a hybrid work model.

• Maintaining and improving SAP master data, including material creation, sales item maintenance, product group structures and customer segmentation.

• Developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, including baselines, forecasts, milestones, resources and critical-path activities.

• Monitoring project progress, costs, revenue and cash flow, and providing regular reports and forecasts to the project team and relevant stakeholders.

• Identifying scheduling or cost deviations and working with project managers to define practical corrective actions.

• Creating, administering and maintaining advance payment guarantees, warranty guarantees and other project-related financial securities.

• Providing operational support and backup during peak workload periods and planned absences within the sales administration team.

• Supporting project risk, change, contract and claims management by assessing potential schedule and cost impacts and contributing to mitigation plans.

• Coordinating planning activities with engineering, procurement, finance, customers, contractors and other stakeholders while contributing to improvements in local tools and processes.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• Hands-on experience using SAP for master data maintenance, material creation, sales item maintenance or related sales administration tasks.

• Experience with project planning, project control, project coordination or a related area.

• Ability to develop and maintain project schedules and analyze milestones, dependencies and critical paths.

• Experience monitoring project costs, forecasts, cash flow or other financial project information.

• Experience with financial guarantees, commercial administration or similar project-related documentation is helpful.

• Familiarity with project risks, changes, contracts or claims is helpful.

• A relevant educational background in engineering, finance, business, project management or another applicable field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Ability to organize information, manage parallel activities and communicate clearly in English; Danish proficiency is an advantage.

**More About Us

**At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart, alongside team members and colleagues. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Product Marketing Director Morten Hellesøe.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Morten Hellesøe at +4540278387.

The application deadline is 11.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

Project Director, Healthcare – Aarhus

Do you want to take ownership of one of the most strategic and visible programmes in Danish digital health? As Project Director, you will lead a comprehensive, product-strategic initiative for our electronic patient record (EPR) product, which has the potential to become the foundation for international growth. Sounds exciting? Then seize the chance now!

Systematic Healthcare – a coherent healthcare system

Systematics’ healthcare solutions are used by more than 200,000 users in, among others, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK and New Zealand. Our EPR solution is the core system in a hospital and has been developed in close collaboration with our customers.

Experienced Project Director with ownership, impact and business understanding

As Project Director, you will have overall responsibility for one of Systematics’ most strategic initiatives: an extensive, long-term, product-strategic programme for our EPR product. The programme is closely linked to the EPR solution used in Western Denmark today and is characterised by high complexity, both internally and externally, with many stakeholders including our customers.

The role is not only about delivering on time, price, scope and quality - as our new Project Director, you help create the framework for the program and ensure that both our customers and Systematic realise the expected benefits.

You are the programme’s single point of accountability towards both the steering committee, our customers management and the management in Systematic.

The programme is run as a virtual organisation across tracks such as development, product management, customer projects, implementation and operations. You have no direct reports and therefore create results through influence, trust, clear direction and strong governance. You report to the Vice President for the area and work closely with our customers, Product Management and the leadership of the EPR area.

Your primary tasks will include:

• Owning the programme plan, budget and business case, and ensuring a coherent solution and the expected benefits over the programme’s lifetime.

• Establishing and driving the programme’s governance and acting as the programme’s primary representative towards customer and Systematic management, including preparing and presenting decision papers.

• Actively owning and protecting the scope: challenging new requirements, driving priorities and ensuring an effective change management process.

• Owning the roadmap, schedule, milestones, budget and resource plan, and ensuring proactive risk management with timely escalation to the steering committee.

• Ensuring delivery in accordance with the agreements and leading changes and negotiations together with our Sales and Legal teams and the Vice President.

• Managing a complex stakeholder landscape, internally and externally, including customers and their regional top management, political decision-makers, clinical leadership, partners and internal units, and ensuring that the product roadmap is aligned with the programme’s commitments.

• Building and leading the virtual programme organisation across tracks and departments by setting direction, removing obstacles and being an ambassador for culture and collaboration. At the same time, you support the organisational change that the programme entails

You will be based at our office in Aarhus and can expect customer meetings around Denmark. Your success is measured by whether the programme delivers within the agreed time, price, scope and quality, and whether the benefits of the business case are realised. An important success criterion is the trust of customers and management in the programme.

Your competencies and qualifications

We envision that you have 10–15 years of experience in programme and project management, several of them with large, complex IT programmes of similar complexity: multi-year, with several parallel tracks, many stakeholders and organisational interfaces. You hold a master’s degree, for example in engineering, IT or economics, and ideally a certification in programme management, such as PMI PgMP or Axelos MSP.

In addition, we expect that you:

• Have experience from the IT industry and with public customers, large public contracts and politically governed organisations. Experience from the healthcare sector is a significant advantage.

• Have been responsible for budget, business case and contractual commitments, including negotiating changes with customers.

• Have experience reporting to executive management and steering committees, leading in matrix or virtual organisations without formal line authority, and taking part in organisational change.

• Have a strong understanding of business and finance, as well as experience in contract and risk management.

• Speak Danish as your native language and are fluent in English.

As a person, you:

Take ownership: You act as the owner of the programme, not as an administrator of plans and reports, and you have the courage to say no and make difficult prioritisations.

Lead through influence: You create commitment and results without formal authority.

jobs.occupation: Specialist for Treasury Products in Wealth Technology
jobs.description:
Do you have hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension and an interest in financial processes across mortgage banking, asset management, risk, regulatory reporting and liquidity management? Join Treasury Products and help develop modern, robust IT solutions.

You will work with core financial processes and contribute to a strategic programme modernising Treasury’s IT landscape, including SimCorp Dimension, integrations and data.

Your role

Nykredit Wealth Technology delivers IT solutions for key financial business areas. Treasury Products supports mortgage banking, proprietary portfolio management, risk, liquidity management and regulatory reporting.

SimCorp Dimension is central to this business-critical value chain. You will work at the intersection of financial products, business processes, data and technology.

You will join a skilled team and collaborate with business units, vendors and colleagues across Wealth Technology.

Help shape the future Treasury platform

The Treasury Greenfield Programme is modernising Treasury’s IT landscape and strengthening the robustness of the value chain across SimCorp Dimension, surrounding systems, integrations and data sources.

Our ambition is to replace the older on-premises platform with a modern, cloud-based SimCorp Dimension SaaS solution and shape the future SCD setup and Treasury it architecture.

As our new Specialist, you will contribute to this transformation, apply your experience and develop your specialist capabilities.

Your primary responsibilities

• Analyse business needs and translate them into robust, flexible IT solutions

• Develop, configure and implement solutions in SimCorp Dimension

• Collaborate with Treasury, Risk and other business areas

• Contribute to the Treasury Greenfield Programme and future platform

• Solve challenges across processes, data and technology

• Maintain solutions and share knowledge across the team.

Your profile

You may come from an IT role involving SimCorp Dimension and financial solutions or from the business side Front Office, Middle Office or Back Office working with Simcorp Dimension. Hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension is required. You do not need to be an expert, but you must have a solid basic understanding of the platform.

In addition, we imagine that you:

• have a relevant background in IT, economics or finance,

• are interested in Treasury, capital markets and technology,

• are curious and motivated to develop your specialist capabilities,

• work in a structured way, take ownership and follow through,

• collaborate well and communicate complex topics clearly.

Your team

You will join a team that values expertise, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We combine different skills and perspectives in a trusting, informal environment where colleagues help and challenge each other.

We expect curiosity, responsibility and an ambition to develop with the team—not that you know everything from day one.

What we offer

We offer a specialist role combining capital markets, mortgage banking, business and technology in an area of significant importance to Nykredit. You can develop your Treasury and SimCorp Dimension expertise while contributing to a strategic transformation. You will work with committed colleagues and take on greater responsibility as your expertise grows.

We also offer competitive employment terms, attractive employee benefits and flexible working conditions.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact me, Thomas Skou, Head of Department, at +45 44 55 99 48.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our Recruitment Team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

Your primary responsibilities:

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

Are you the one we are looking for?

We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your new team

You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

About Nykredit Markets

Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

Want to know more?

You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Passionate About Food and Great Service? Join Our Team at Arla Unika

Do you love great food, enjoy connecting with people, and have a passion for creating memorable customer experiences? Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for to join our exclusive cheese shop in Torvehallerne, Copenhagen!

At Arla Unika, cheese is much more than just cheese. Behind every cheese is a story of craftsmanship, innovation, and a dedication to creating exceptional taste experiences. We are passionate about sharing that story with our customers and turning every visit into something special.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded part-time colleague to join our team.

How you will make an impact

As part of our team, you’ll be the face of Arla Unika, playing an important role in creating exceptional customer experiences. Your job is not simply to sell cheese, but to inspire, guide, and encourage our customers to discover new flavours.

Your daily responsibilities will include providing personal and attentive customer service, advising customers, cutting and wrapping cheeses, and introducing customers to our products through tastings and recommendations.

Together with your colleagues, you’ll help ensure that our shop always looks inviting and that every customer leaves with a great experience and a reason to return.

What will make you successful

We imagine that you

• Have a genuine interest in food and gastronomy and enjoy sharing your enthusiasm with others.

• Are outgoing, approachable, and naturally enjoy connecting with customers.

• Ideally have experience in hospitality or customer service, with previous sales experience being an advantage.

• Can stay calm, positive, and organised, even during busy periods.

• Enjoy an active working environment where physical tasks are part of the day.

• Are responsible, flexible, and always willing to support your colleagues when needed.

• Are curious, eager to learn, and excited to develop your knowledge of cheese, flavours, and gastronomy.

You don’t need to be a cheese expert to join us! What matters most is your willingness to learn, your appreciation for quality food, and your natural ability to make people feel welcome.

What Do We Offer?

At Arla Unika, you’ll become part of a dedicated and supportive team where we share knowledge, help each other, and take pride in delivering outstanding service and gastronomic experiences.

We offer

• An attractive salary package, including pension.

• A dynamic and inspiring workplace in the heart of Torvehallerne, surrounded by food enthusiasts and culinary experiences.

• The opportunity to work with some of Denmark’s most exclusive cheeses.

• Thorough training and the chance to develop your knowledge of cheese, gastronomy, and sales.

• Opportunities to participate in cheese tastings, food festivals, and other exciting events.

• Flexible working hours, with shifts on weekdays and weekends, including afternoons and evenings, making it possible to combine the job with your studies.

Would you like to join us ?

Does this sound like the perfect opportunity for you? We’d love to hear from you!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact our Store Manager, Becky Nielsen, at beckn@arlafoods.com.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation letter through the application link below.

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the Arla Unika team!

**We have a purpose for Good

**At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?

BEWARE! RECRUITMENT FRAUD

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.
